answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock collateral, mirroring the structural integrity of a trellis supporting growth. An attacker seeking to flood the network must acquire a dominant share of the supply, akin to scaling a steep knoll, which imposes prohibitive capital costs. By anchoring trust in economic value rather than identity, the system remains as resilient as onyx, ensuring that the influence of each agent is strictly proportional to their verifiable risk.
